title: Emergence — Idea
description: The real shape returned by idea-store's add() (a real WARP Gate, guarded by the idea:text-required hard Axiom) and read by list()/search()/findById(). Refactored from build-tools/rheon-idea-os/storage/IdeaStore.js -- see components/idea-store/component.spec for the full lineage.

id.description: 8 hex chars, crypto.randomBytes(4). Not content-addressed (unlike the underlying storage) -- a stable handle you use as a target.id.

ts.description: Unix millisecond timestamp, Date.now() at add() time.

text.description: Required, trimmed, non-empty -- enforced by the real idea:text-required hard Axiom, not a post-hoc check.

source.description: 'cli' | 'api' by the original convention, not enforced as an enum here.
